entities.summary: Thomas Robsahm (b. 1964-04-29, Arendal) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Arendal and Norway. Known in the fields of norway, composers & musicians, europe.
